theme: Sabbath Camp: A Friend at All Times
summary: Sabbath Camp looks back at the friendship of David and Jonathan: a covenant, a robe, speaking up, the arrows signal, and strengthening each other in God, even when Saul was jealous.

story_reel.narration: Welcome to Sabbath Camp! This week was all about friendship. Let's remember. After David defeated Goliath, Prince Jonathan's heart was knit with David's. Jonathan made a covenant of friendship and gave David his own robe, armor, sword, bow, and belt. Saul became jealous when the women sang about David's ten thousands. He even threw his spear at David. But David kept acting wisely, and Yahweh was with him. Jonathan bravely spoke up for David to his father. Michal helped David escape through a window. Jonathan and David made a secret plan with arrows, and when Jonathan learned the truth, he warned David. They hugged and cried, and said goodbye in the name of Yahweh. In the wilderness, Jonathan found David and strengthened his faith in God. This week's big truth: you can be a friend who loves at all times. In good times and hard times. When it's easy, and when it costs you something. Jonathan's friendship didn't depend on what David could do for him. And the best friend of all is Jesus, who loves you at all times.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can be a friend who loves at all times.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Milestone: You can be a friend who loves at all times! Make a 'friendship covenant' in your Blueprint journal. Write three promises you want to keep as a friend.

quiz.question: What did Jonathan give David to show his friendship?
options: His robe, armor, sword, bow, and belt
quiz.explanation: Jonathan gave David his robe, sword, bow, and sash.

quiz.question: Why was Saul jealous of David?
options: The women sang that David defeated ten thousands
quiz.explanation: The women sang, 'Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.'

quiz.question: What does a friend do, according to Proverbs?
quiz.explanation: A friend loves at all times.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, thank You for friends who love me at all times. Help me be that kind of friend. And thank You for Jesus, the best Friend of all. Amen.

companion.message: Realm 24 complete! Jonathan was a friend who loved at all times. Next, you'll see what I did when I had the chance to get revenge on Saul, and hear some of my favorite songs.
